title: Ausgewählte Werke Bd. 2 (German, 1922)
author: Vladimir Solovyov
description: The second volume of Vladimir Solovyov's selected works in the supplied German edition. It continues access to a philosophical project concerned with spiritual unity, moral responsibility and the relationship between religion and thought.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ausgewhltewerk02solouoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
